verdict.rationale: The Cactus engine says it can route hard queries to the cloud automatically based on local model confidence, and a user mentions running 'Cactus Hybrid', so local and cloud inference coexist in one engine. The evidence is a single README line, though, and says nothing about choosing or configuring cloud AI providers yourself. Missing for 10: documentation of which cloud providers are supported, user-configurable provider/API-key setup, manual (not only automatic) switching between cloud and local models in the same interface, independent hands-on confirmation of the cloud handoff.
